key_findings: Headline Claim 4 of Experiment 2 repro-duced exactly: rumination x (baseline vs suppressed) free-association interaction F(1,48)=6.21 [paper 6.20], MSE=745.98 [paper 746.04], p=.016 [paper .016], partial eta^2=.115 [paper .11], from the shared Ashley_labels.sav (N=54, 27/group).
Direction confirmed: non-ruminators show suppression-induced forgetting (baseline 45.68% -> suppress 29.63% negative meaning); ruminators show none (40.12% -> 42.59%).

The df(1,48) error term is reproduced by a mixed ANOVA with between-subjects factors rumination Group x counterbalancing CB (6 cells) and within-subjects factors cond(2:base,supp) x cue-type(2:homograph,nonhomograph); SS error = 35806.88/48 = 745.98.
Matches human FLoRA reproduction (Grigoryev, SCORE 2y474) which rated the claim 'precise reproduction'/'did reproduce'; Zogmaister workbook (24773) targets the same Claim 4.
MSE at last digit differs by 0.008% (745.98 vs 746.04) - rounding-level, non-substantive.
Only Experiment 2 data were shared on OSF; Experiment 1 (valence-latency/flanker) claims cannot be independently re-run from shared data.
notes: OSF project 'SCORE - Hertel_ClinPsychSci_2018_YabW' (node re9mu) with author data in 'Original Materials' (u7rqk: Ashley_labels.sav) and reproductions by Grigoryev (57pn2) and Zogmaister (ktx9s).
